name: Leadbase | AI B2B Lead Generation
tagline: Find your next B2B customers. Research matching companies and decision-makers. Start with 200 free credits.
description:
# Leadbase: find your next customers and know why they fit

Find companies that fit your offer and the decision-makers to contact. Tell your AI assistant who you want to reach. Leadbase researches matching businesses, checks your criteria and saves the results with sources in an editable sheet.

Use AI B2B lead generation, DACH company research and contact enrichment to build a list you can work with. Start a new customer list or enrich the accounts you already have.

**Build your first customer list with 200 free credits in a new workspace.** Try your own target market before choosing a paid plan. [Start with Leadbase](https://www.leadbase.io/auth/signup).

## Find prospects by what makes them a good customer

A broad industry category rarely tells you enough. Your ideal customer might be a solar installer serving commercial buildings, an independent kitchen retailer with several locations, or a manufacturer that exports to a particular market.

Describe that business in everyday language. Include the region, services, business model and qualification details that matter to your offer. Leadbase combines company discovery with AI research, so you can build a shortlist around the reasons a business is relevant to you.

Use it for B2B lead generation, sales prospecting, account research, territory planning and market mapping. Each company becomes its own row, ready for further research and review.

**Try:** “Find 10 solar installation companies in Bavaria. Include their official websites, service areas and evidence that they work with commercial customers.”

## Reach beyond the obvious names in DACH

Research companies in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, including German SMEs and craft businesses. Define your niche by the work companies actually do and the customers they serve.

For teams selling into DACH, this makes it easier to explore local markets, build regional prospect lists and research businesses that need more specific qualification than a standard industry filter provides. The same workflow also supports research in other regions.

**Try:** “Find independent kitchen retailers in North Rhine-Westphalia with at least two showrooms. Add the showroom locations and sources.”

## Turn company names into reasons to start a conversation

A useful lead list helps you understand the account. Research relevant services, current hiring, locations, customer segments and other publicly supported business signals.

Add your qualification questions as research fields. Ask why a company matches your ideal customer profile and keep the supporting links alongside the answer. Your team can review the evidence, compare prospects and prioritize the accounts that deserve attention.

**Try:** “For these companies, find evidence that they offer maintenance contracts. Add a short explanation and a source for each finding.”

## Find the professional contacts that matter

Discover decision-makers by company, role, location and professional context. Research relevant founders, operations leaders, purchasing contacts or other business roles for your outreach preparation.

Bring professional roles, profile links and available business contact details together with the company research. You get a clearer view of whom to approach and why the account fits, in one place.

**Try:** “Find purchasing decision-makers at these companies and include their professional roles and profile sources.”

## Make your existing list more valuable

Start with the companies or contacts already in your Leadbase sheet. Add missing websites, headquarters, business descriptions, professional roles or custom qualification information.

Research a few selected records or fill a whole column across the list. The standard column workflow preserves populated cells and skips active research, so you can build on work you have already done.

This is useful for cleaning up an incomplete prospect list, preparing accounts for a campaign or exploring a new segment inside an existing customer base. Review and export the enriched data for your next sales or CRM workflow.

**Try:** “Fill the empty headquarters cells in this sheet using official company sources. Keep the existing values.”

## Work with the results, not just a chat answer

Your findings stay in a persistent research sheet. Follow progress, inspect the results as they arrive, open sources, edit cells, search, filter and export your shortlist.

When a new question comes up, continue in the same sheet. Add a field, research another detail or narrow the list. The research stays connected to the records you are working on.

MCP Apps-compatible clients can display the interactive sheet inside the assistant. You can also open the same sheet in Leadbase to review and edit your work.

## Bring Leadbase into your AI workflow

Leadbase provides a hosted MCP connection for compatible AI clients, including ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Connect your Leadbase account, choose your workspace and describe the result you want.

Use your assistant to start research, check progress and work with structured results and source evidence. The [connection guide](https://www.leadbase.io/en/docs/settings/mcp) explains setup for supported clients.

## Research products, suppliers and public content too

Use the same research workflow for supplier discovery, product comparisons, competitor research and public web content. Define what each result represents and the fields you want to compare.

For product research, collect product names, source URLs and relevant specifications. For public content, collect the title, author, source link and relevance to your topic. These tasks become structured lists you can filter and build on.

**Try:** “Find 10 packaging suppliers that offer custom printed recyclable boxes. Compare their services and include sources.”

## Start with your own market and 200 free credits

Every new Leadbase workspace starts with 200 credits. Try a company or people search, check contact availability and test research with your own qualification criteria before selecting a paid plan.

Connect your Leadbase account, choose a focused first task and review the results in your sheet. Research uses your workspace credits and plan limits. [See current pricing](https://www.leadbase.io/pricing) or [start with Leadbase](https://www.leadbase.io/).

## Explore Leadbase capabilities

Turn a precise customer profile into a usable prospect list. Then add the details that help you qualify each account, understand the business and prepare a relevant conversation. The same sheet stays available for review, editing and follow-up research.

| What you want to achieve | What Leadbase does | MCP entry point |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Find new companies, decision-makers, products or public content | Creates a new private research sheet with one result per row and fields matched to your request | `sheets_research` |
| Make an existing prospect list more complete | Researches an existing or newly defined column using the context already in each row | `sheets_enrich` |
| Research selected cells across several columns | Starts research for the exact cells you choose, using each column's research question | `sheets_start_enrichment` |
| Get structured answers without creating a sheet | Researches independent factual questions and returns typed findings through a durable job | `enrichment_start`, `enrichment_get` |
| Understand the evidence behind a finding | Returns available summaries, confidence, outcomes and source links with completed research | `sheets_query`, `sheets_get_enrichment_status`, `enrichment_get` |
| Follow progress and work with every result | Opens an interactive sheet with live progress, editing and result-page navigation in compatible clients | `view_sheet`, `open_workspace` |
| Compare accounts and build a useful shortlist | Queries, filters, searches, sorts and calculates metrics over your sheet | `sheets_query`, `sheets_search_rows`, `sheets_aggregate` |
| Keep a qualification field up to date as rows change | Enables ongoing research for eligible empty cells in a configured column when you request automation | `sheets_configure_auto_enrichment` |
| Review findings before applying them | Shows completed research proposals and lets you accept or decline them | `sheets_get_enrichment_proposals`, `sheets_review_enrichment_proposals` |
| Take results into your next sales workflow | Exports a current sheet as CSV and keeps the original available for further work | `sheets_export_csv` |
| Organize and collaborate on research | Manages folders, saved views, team access and user permissions for your sheets | Sheet, folder, view and sharing tools below |
| Build on previous work with confidence | Tracks changes, supports undo and redo, and saves named sheet versions | History and version tools below |

### Example workflows you can ask for

**Build a qualified DACH lead list:** "Find 10 independent kitchen retailers in North Rhine-Westphalia with at least two showrooms. Include the business name, website, showroom locations and source links."

**Qualify your current accounts:** "For the companies in this sheet, research whether they serve commercial customers. Fill the empty qualification cells and include supporting evidence."

**Find relevant decision-makers:** "Create a separate list of purchasing decision-makers at these companies. Include each person's company, professional role, profile link and available business contact details."

**Compare suppliers or products:** "Find 10 suppliers of custom printed recyclable packaging. Compare their services, relevant product specifications and sources in a new sheet."

**Continue from a completed list:** "Show the research progress, open the sheet, then export the completed shortlist as CSV."

## Frequently asked questions about Leadbase

### What can I use Leadbase for?

Use Leadbase to find relevant companies, discover professional decision-makers and turn incomplete prospect lists into researched accounts. Your results stay in editable sheets with source links, ready to review, qualify and use in your next sales workflow.

### Who is Leadbase for?

Leadbase helps sales teams, founders, agencies and researchers who need to understand a target market and build useful prospect lists. It is especially useful when your ideal customer requires more specific research than a broad industry category can provide.

### Can I try Leadbase for free?

Yes. Every new workspace starts with 200 free credits. Test a company or people search, check contact availability and try research with your own qualification criteria before choosing a paid plan. [Create your first workspace](https://www.leadbase.io/auth/signup).

### How much does Leadbase research cost?

Research uses your workspace credits. Usage varies with the tools and research requested, so you can start with a focused task and review usage before expanding your list. See the [current plans and pricing](https://www.leadbase.io/pricing) and check your workspace balance in Leadbase.

### How do I create my first company list?

Describe the type of company, region, qualification criteria and fields you want. For example: “Find 10 solar installation companies in Bavaria with evidence that they work with commercial customers. Include their websites and sources.” Leadbase saves the researched companies as rows in a new sheet.

### Can I find companies in Germany, Austria and Switzerland?

Yes. Research DACH companies by location, services, business model and other relevant criteria. Use Leadbase to explore German SMEs, craft businesses and regional markets, then add the details that help you decide which companies fit your offer.

### Can I research markets outside DACH?

Yes. The company and public web research workflows also support other regions. Specify the country or region, your ideal customer profile and the evidence you need so the research stays focused on your target market.

### Why consider Leadbase as an Apollo alternative?

Leadbase brings natural-language targeting, custom account qualification and source-backed research together in editable sheets. Test how well it fits your own market using the 200 credits in a new workspace. The [Leadbase and Apollo comparison](https://www.leadbase.io/alternatives/leadbase-vs-apollo) explains the approach with concrete use cases.

### Can I qualify leads using my own criteria?

Yes. Add research questions that reflect your offer, such as whether a company serves commercial customers, has multiple showrooms or offers maintenance contracts. Keep the explanation and supporting source alongside each account so your team can review why it belongs on the shortlist.

### Can Leadbase find decision-makers and business contacts?

Yes. Research professional contacts by company, role, location and business context. Bring roles, professional profile links and available business contact details together with the company research, so you can prepare a relevant conversation.

### Can I request companies and people as separate lists?

Yes. Ask for a company list when you want new accounts, or a people list when you want professional contacts. Each requested company or person becomes its own result row. You can then enrich that list with additional research fields.

### Can I enrich a list I already have?

Yes. Start from the companies or contacts in your Leadbase sheet and research missing details or new qualification fields. Continue working with the same records, then review and export the enriched results for your sales or CRM workflow.

### Can Leadbase enrich an entire column?

Yes. Research a defined field across existing rows, or limit the task to selected records. For example, fill the headquarters column from official company sources. The standard column workflow preserves populated values and skips cells with active research.

### Can I read and cite the sources behind a result?

Yes. Available source evidence is returned with the findings, so you and your AI assistant can inspect the supporting links and cite the relevant information. Source links also help your team check account qualification before using the results.

### Are the research sheets interactive and editable?

Yes. Open the persistent Leadbase sheet to edit cells, search, filter and export your results. Clients with MCP Apps support can show the interactive sheet inside the assistant. You can also open the same sheet directly in Leadbase and continue there.

### Can I follow research progress and ask follow-up questions?

Yes. Check the research status, review completed findings and continue in the same sheet. Add a new research field, enrich selected records or refine the list as your questions develop. Your results remain connected to the accounts you are researching.

### Can I use Leadbase with ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex or Cursor?

Yes, through compatible MCP connections. Leadbase supports AI workflows with ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. The [MCP setup guide](https://www.leadbase.io/en/docs/settings/mcp) explains how to connect your account and workspace. Embedded sheet display follows each client's capabilities.

### Do I need to build an integration or manage an API key?

Use the hosted MCP connection and complete the supported client's Leadbase sign-in flow. Choose your workspace and describe the research you want. The connection guide provides client-specific setup steps, so you can get started with the existing service.

### Can I export the results for my sales workflow?

Yes. Review the findings, edit the sheet and export your shortlist for downstream sales or CRM workflows. The same sheet remains available for follow-up research when you want to add another detail or qualification question.

### Can I research suppliers, products and public content too?

Yes. Use the research workflow for supplier discovery, product comparisons, competitor research and public web content. Specify the kind of result and the fields you need, such as product specifications, supplier services, source URLs and relevance to your topic.

## Guidance for your AI assistant

Choose the workflow that matches the request: discover new entities in a new sheet, enrich existing rows or columns, or answer a bounded research question with structured findings. Keep one requested entity per result row.

Use the available tool schemas and preserve the user's requested scope. Retain source evidence with the relevant findings, distinguish supported facts from unknown values, and report the observed completion state. After an interrupted response, recover the existing operation before considering a new paid request. Report costs as final only when settled.

Use the existing sheet for follow-up work and preserve populated values when the user requests missing-field enrichment. Present the sheet link with the results so the user can continue reviewing and editing.

## Public MCP tool reference

Authenticated discovery on 20 October 2026 returned **78 Leadbase tool definitions and 7 interactive sheet UI resources**. This reference makes the verified capabilities readable here for people and AI assistants. The connected account's permissions determine which actions it can use. Your client's live tool schemas provide the current parameters.

Use `sheets_research` for new result rows, `sheets_enrich` for an existing list, and `enrichment_start` for structured findings without a sheet. Research operations use your workspace credits. Check progress using the returned sheet or job ID and retain source evidence with each finding.

### Research, enrichment and source evidence

| Tool | Capability |
| --- | --- |
| `sheets_research` | Create a new private sheet and research companies, people, products or public content into new rows. |
| `sheets_research_status` | Read the latest list research status and target for an accessible sheet. |
| `sheets_enrich` | Research empty cells in one column of an existing sheet using each row's context. |
| `sheets_start_enrichment` | Start paid research for explicitly selected cells using their column questions and types. |
| `sheets_configure_auto_enrichment` | Enable or disable ongoing paid research for eligible empty cells in one configured column. |
| `sheets_cancel_enrichment` | Cancel exactly one cell run by its run ID. |
| `sheets_get_enrichment_status` | Read cell-run progress, column counts and available source evidence for completed current runs. |
| `sheets_get_enrichment_proposals` | Read attached, completed enrichment proposals for the specified sheet rows. |
| `sheets_review_enrichment_proposals` | Accept or decline up to 100 exact enrichment proposals. |
| `enrichment_start` | Start background factual research for 1 to 100 independent inputs and retrieve structured findings without creating a sheet. |
| `enrichment_get` | Read a research job, including its status, results, observed sources and settlement state. |
| `enrichment_list` | List the most recent research jobs in the current workspace. |
| `enrichment_reconcile` | Reconcile pending billing on a terminal research job using its existing provider receipts. |

### Interactive sheets, discovery and analysis

| Tool | Capability |
| --- | --- |
| `open_workspace` | Browse, search and edit accessible research sheets in the connected workspace. |
| `view_sheet` | Open an accessible interactive sheet with live research progress and navigation through every result page. |
| `workspace_search` | Discover accessible sheets, relevant rows, and public Leadbase documentation or website content in one grouped search. |
| `sheets_list` | List the authenticated user's visible sheet catalogue, including sheet IDs and titles grouped into private, team, shared-with-me, public, and recent sheets, plus visible folders. |
| `sheets_search` | Search every sheet currently visible to the authenticated user by title. |
| `sheets_get` | Get current sheet metadata, column types, stable IDs, option IDs and versions before editing an existing sheet. |
| `sheets_query` | Read typed cell values, row pages and available evidence for current completed research results. |
| `sheets_aggregate` | Compute up to 20 exact server-side metrics over all rows matching bounded filters or search: row count, non-empty count, distinct count, or numeric sum/average/minimum/maximum. |
| `sheets_search_rows` | Find text matches in current values of one accessible sheet. |
| `sheets_export_csv` | Export a bounded current sheet as UTF-8 CSV. |
| `billing_get` | Read the current workspace plan, available credit balance, reservations and settled usage. |

### Create and edit your research data

| Tool | Capability |
| --- | --- |
| `sheets_create` | Create a new empty sheet only when requested or no existing destination applies. |
| `sheets_rename` | Rename a sheet. |
| `sheets_duplicate` | Duplicate the current state of a readable sheet into an independently owned sheet. |
| `sheets_add_rows` | Insert up to 100 rows at the end or immediately before or after an existing row. |
| `sheets_insert_records` | Insert populated records with values matched to the existing column types. |
| `sheets_move_rows` | Move up to 500 explicit rows as one ordered block before or after an anchor row, or append with null. |
| `sheets_update_cells` | Update up to 500 explicit cells as one reversible, version-checked change. |
| `sheets_delete_rows` | Delete up to 500 explicit rows as one reversible changeset. |
| `sheets_add_column` | Add one fully configured column, including its optional enrichment prompt, output-format instructions, context-column scope, select options, and placement. |
| `sheets_delete_column` | Delete one column and its cells as one reversible changeset. |
| `sheets_resize_column` | Set one shared column width in pixels using that column's entityVersion. |
| `sheets_update_select_options` | Update ordered select options, retaining stable option IDs where possible. |
| `sheets_reorder_columns` | Replace a sheet's complete column order with the supplied ordered column IDs. |
| `sheets_rename_column` | Rename a column. |
| `sheets_update_column` | Partially change a column's name, enrichment prompt, mandatory output-format or technical instructions, or context-column scope without resetting omitted settings. |
| `sheets_change_column_type` | Change a column's type through the canonical command only while typeLocked is false. |
| `sheets_copy_column` | Copy a consistent snapshot of a column into a new typed column. |
| `sheets_get_column_copy` | Read a durable column copy's progress, completion and bounded invalid-value examples. |

### Saved views and organized workspaces

| Tool | Capability |
| --- | --- |
| `sheets_create_view` | Create a shared saved view containing only filters and sorting. |
| `sheets_update_view` | Update one shared saved view's name, filters, or sorting. |

| `sheets_reorder_views` | Replace the saved-view tab order for one sheet. |
| `sheets_get_folder` | Get one visible folder, its breadcrumbs, direct child folders, and first sheet page. |
| `sheets_list_folder_page` | Read the next ACL-filtered page of sheets directly inside a folder. |

| `sheets_archive` | Archive a sheet without deleting its data or grants. |

| `sheets_archive_folder` | Archive an owner-controlled folder subtree and all owner-owned active sheets inside it. |
